note: Paper trades only: no money is placed. Rules fixed on 20 Nov 2026 and never changed afterwards; entry is the first NSE close after the news reached readers, exit the close 'hold' sessions later, net of 0.3% round-trip costs. Educational; not investment advice.

strategies.name: Buy the fall
strategies.rule: PulsEdge flags bad news on a stock (an AI call pointing down) and the stock has already fallen 3% or more from the close before the news to the first close after it reached readers: buy at that close, sell at the next close.
strategies.earlier: 9-19 Nov replay: 24 trades, 58% won, +0.42% a trade after costs (8 of them on 18 Nov; not proven)

strategies.name: Act on Sell alerts
strategies.rule: Every Sell (Act) alert: short at the first close after it reached readers, buy back at the next close. In practice this needs futures or an intraday short; for a holder it means selling.
strategies.earlier: 9-19 Nov replay: 25 trades, 48% won, -0.06% a trade after costs (Sell alerts beat Buy alerts, but not costs)

strategies.name: Fade the jump
strategies.rule: PulsEdge flags good news (an AI call pointing up) and the stock has already risen 3% or more by the first close after the news reached readers: short at that close, buy back five sessions later.
strategies.earlier: 9-19 Nov replay: 28 trades, 75% won, +1.11% a trade after costs, 12 of them on 11 Nov (not proven)

strategies.name: Follow every Act alert (baseline)
strategies.rule: Every Act alert in the alert's direction: buy if it points up, short if down, at the first close after it reached readers; exit at the next close. The yardstick the others must beat.
strategies.earlier: 9-19 Nov replay: 70 trades, 39% won, -0.18% a trade after costs
